_comment: Base items. weight in pounds, value in copper (1 gp = 100 cp, 1 sp = 10 cp). Weapons and armour follow SRD 5.1 (CC-BY-4.0). covers = body parts protected. Clothing: warmth 0-10, wind/water resistance 0-1, social -2 (rags) to +3 (courtly).
_upkeep: Gear in use (game/gear.py). wear: the chance that a blow given (weapon) or taken (armour, shield, helmet) costs one point of condition, divided by the quality's durability. battered: below this condition armour gives 1 less AC and a weapon 1 less to hit. mend: an hour's work with tools mends up to 'items' things by step (step_trained if trained with the tool) up to cap (cap_trained), unless the tool says its own cap. hone: a whetstone's minutes, the damage it adds until the next fight, and the condition it grinds edged weapons back up to. snare: Survival DC for snares and traps set overnight (the land's hunting DC plus this). escape: each day, the chance a prisoner slips away when bound with nothing better than a belt, with rope, or in manacles. evening: once a day, music (a Performance check against dc) or a game cheers each companion by loyalty, up to cap (content, not devoted: devotion is earned by deeds). prayer: hours the comfort of prayer lasts (+1 to Wisdom saves).

lance.name: lance
lance.description: A long ash shaft with a steel point, made to be couched from the saddle. On foot it takes both hands.

trident.name: trident
trident.description: Three barbed tines on a shaft: a fisher's spear and a fighter's.

whip.name: whip
whip.description: A drover's lash of plaited leather. It reaches ten feet and stings the legs.

blowgun.name: blowgun
blowgun.description: A hollow reed as long as an arm. Its needles sting more than they wound.

musket.name: musket
musket.description: Gnomish work: a long iron tube bound to a stock, fired with black powder and a spark. Never sold in an ordinary shop.

pistol.name: pistol
pistol.description: Gnomish work: a short iron barrel and a wheel that strikes the spark. Loud enough to stop a tavern.

needles.name: blowgun needle
needles.description: Fine iron needles, fifty to a case.

firearm_bullets.name: firearm bullet
firearm_bullets.description: Lead balls and a measure of black powder for each, wrapped in paper. Gnomish.

common_clothes.name: common clothes
common_clothes.description: A wool tunic, hose and a belt.

dark_clothes.name: dark clothes
dark_clothes.description: Drab, close-fitting clothes in black and brown.

travelers_clothes.name: traveller's clothes
travelers_clothes.description: Thick wool and leather patches, made for the road.

fine_clothes.name: fine clothes
fine_clothes.description: Dyed wool and silk, embroidered at the collar.

vestments.name: vestments
vestments.description: Priestly robes in the colours of a faith.

backpack.name: backpack
backpack.description: Leather, with good straps and a flap against the rain.

bedroll.name: bedroll
bedroll.description: A rolled blanket and ground-sheet. Keeps the cold earth off you.

candle.name: tallow candle
candle.description: A small, smoky light, but it burns for hours. Underground it is what you light when the torches run out.

torch.name: torch
torch.description: Pitch-soaked rags on a stick. Burns about an hour.

oil_flask.name: flask of oil
oil_flask.description: Lamp oil: a lantern burns six hours on a flask.

tinderbox.name: tinderbox
tinderbox.how: It lights the fire at camp (r, then f).

crowbar.name: crowbar
crowbar.how: Walk into a locked door or chest with it in the pack: forcing it open is easier, and quieter.
crowbar.description: An iron bar with a flattened end. Locks, lids and doors give to it that would not give to a shoulder, and with less noise.

rope.name: hempen rope (50 ft)
rope.how: It is used where it is needed: to bind prisoners, to haul a friend up, to go over a wall with a grappling hook.
rope.description: Fifty feet of good hemp. Prisoners tied with it seldom slip away, and some things on the road need a rope.

grappling_hook.name: grappling hook
grappling_hook.how: With a rope, it takes you over a town wall when the gate is shut, and down a cliff the road goes round.
grappling_hook.description: Three iron claws on a ring. Tied to a rope, it gets you up walls and down cliffs.

iron_pot.name: iron pot
iron_pot.how: Used at camp to cook oats into porridge and to boil water safe (r).

mess_kit.name: mess kit
mess_kit.how: Used at camp to cook oats into porridge and to boil water safe (r).

sack.name: sack
sack.description: A hemp sack, slung over a shoulder. Better than nothing; a backpack is better.

shovel.name: shovel
shovel.how: At camp, build a shelter with it (r, then t): you dig in, in half the time and with less to go wrong.
shovel.description: A rough shelter goes up twice as fast when you can dig in, and in snow you can make a snow-hole that keeps out the worst cold.

hunting_trap.name: hunting trap
hunting_trap.description: A great iron trap with teeth. Set it at camp before you sleep, and in the morning there may be a deer or a boar in it.

fishing_tackle.name: fishing tackle
fishing_tackle.how: Used when you fish at camp by a river, lake or marsh (r, then i): far better than a bent pin.

tent.name: tent (two-person)
tent.how: Pitch it at camp (r, then t): out of the wind and the wet, and a fire will burn in its lee in a storm.

bell_line.name: string of bells
bell_line.how: Carried, it is strung round the camp whenever you sleep in the wild.
bell_line.description: Little bells on a long cord, strung round a camp at night. Whoever comes creeping in sets them ringing, and nobody is caught asleep.

snares.name: wire snares
snares.description: A dozen loops of wire. Set them round the camp before you sleep, and there may be a hare or a bird in one by morning.

navigators_tools.name: navigator's tools
navigators_tools.how: Carried, it helps you keep your bearings in fog, storm and darkness.
navigators_tools.description: A lodestone needle in a bowl, a sighting rod and tables of the stars. Off the roads in bad light it helps keep your bearings: +4 against getting lost, more if you were taught to use it.

uses.text: Find your position by the stars

spyglass.name: spyglass
spyglass.how: Carried, it lets you see further across open country by day, and spot trouble on the road sooner.
spyglass.description: Ground lenses in a brass tube, with a cap to keep the rain off them.

whetstone.name: whetstone
whetstone.description: Twenty minutes on a whetstone puts an edge back on every blade in the party: +1 damage with swords, axes and spears until the next fight, and the worst nicks ground out.

soap.name: soap
soap.how: It is used when you wash (w, where there is water): one bar for the party.
soap.description: Lye soap. Washing with it takes every bit of the grime off, and cleans open wounds while it is at it.

splint.name: splint
splint.how: Used on a broken bone on the Health screen (h), so it heals straight.

needle_thread.name: needle and thread
needle_thread.description: For stitching wounds, and for mending torn clothes and padded jacks.

healers_kit.name: healer's kit
healers_kit.description: Bandages, salves, a needle, a small knife and a bottle of spirits.

holy_symbol.name: holy symbol
holy_symbol.description: The emblem of a faith, worn on a chain. It focuses a priest's prayers.

prayer_book.name: prayer book
prayer_book.description: The rites and prayers of a faith, written out in full. An hour of prayer from it once a day steadies anyone; a priest gets back one of the day's spent spells. Burn incense with it, and the whole party is steadied.

old_map.name: old map
old_map.description: Vellum, folded to softness, marked in a careful hand. Read it to put what it shows on your own map.

history_book.name: book of histories
history_book.description: Somebody's account of who held this country, and what became of them.

lore_book.name: book of old lore
lore_book.description: Lost things, old things, and where they were last seen.

found_letter.name: water-stained letter
found_letter.description: Somebody wrote this and did not come home. Read it.

sealed_crate.name: sealed crate
sealed_crate.description: Nailed shut, unmarked, and heavier than it looks. Whatever is in it, somebody wants it somewhere it is not allowed.

sealed_letter.name: sealed letter
sealed_letter.description: Folded, sealed with wax, and not for you. Breaking the seal would show.

incense.name: block of incense
incense.how: It is burned when someone prays from a prayer book (Enter on the book): then the whole party shares the comfort of the prayer.
incense.description: Resin and sweet herbs pressed into a block. Burned at prayer, its smoke reaches everyone in the camp.

spellbook.name: spellbook
spellbook.how: A wizard's spells are in it: copy new ones in from scrolls (Enter on a scroll), cast from the Spells screen (S).
spellbook.description: Vellum pages dense with diagrams and notation. Worth more than your life to you.

component_pouch.name: component pouch
component_pouch.description: A belt pouch of little compartments: sulphur, bat dung, a pinch of sand, a feather. Everything a wizard's spells need.

arcane_focus.name: crystal focus
arcane_focus.description: A rod of clear crystal. In a wizard's hand it gathers the magic.

ink_and_quill.name: ink and quill
ink_and_quill.description: With a sheet of parchment, a caster can write one of their spells out as a scroll, to be read once later: on the Spells screen (S), choose the spell and press w.

parchment.name: sheet of parchment
parchment.how: Write a spell scroll on it with ink and quill: Spells screen (S), choose the spell, w.
parchment.description: Scraped and smoothed calfskin. A spell scroll needs one sheet.

thieves_tools.name: thieves' tools
thieves_tools.how: Carried, it picks the locks of doors and chests underground: those trained with it add their proficiency, and with Sleight of Hand as well they have advantage.

disguise_kit.name: disguise kit
disguise_kit.description: Paints, powders, false hair, a little mirror. Enough to become someone else for a day.

herbalism_kit.name: herbalism kit
herbalism_kit.how: Used on the Health screen (h) to treat the sick and wounded, and at camp (m) to make antitoxin and remedies.

smiths_tools.name: smith's tools
smiths_tools.description: Hammers, tongs, a file and rivets. An hour's work mends dented armour, bent blades and sprung rings: well, if you were trained to it.

uses.text: Pry open a door or container

carpenters_tools.name: carpenter's tools
carpenters_tools.description: Saw, adze, chisels and glue. An hour's work mends split shields, cracked bows and loose spear-heads.

uses.text: Seal or pry open a door or container

leatherworkers_tools.name: leatherworker's tools
leatherworkers_tools.description: Awls, a knife, waxed thread and spare buckles. An hour's work mends leather and hide armour, boots, belts, cloaks and clothes.

uses.text: Add a design to a leather item

cooks_utensils.name: cook's utensils
cooks_utensils.how: Used at camp when you eat by the fire (r, then e).
cooks_utensils.description: A pot, a ladle, knives and a bag of spices. A meal by the fire goes further and warms more, a good deal more if the cook knows the work.

dice_set.name: bone dice
dice_set.description: Your own dice, and you know how they fall. A game in the evening cheers the camp; at an inn, those trained with dice throw better.

playing_cards.name: playing cards
playing_cards.description: A greasy deck. A game in the evening cheers the camp; at an inn you can play cards for money, where reading faces (Insight) counts for more than luck.

lute.name: lute
lute.description: Playing for an inn pays better with an instrument, and much better if you were taught it. Music in the evening lifts a camp.

uses.text: Make up a song on the spot

flute.name: bone flute
flute.description: Playing for an inn pays better with an instrument, and much better if you were taught it. Music in the evening lifts a camp.

uses.text: Make up a song on the spot

pedigree_scroll.name: scroll of pedigree
pedigree_scroll.how: Carried, it speaks for you: there is nothing to do with it but have it in the pack.

rank_insignia.name: insignia of rank
rank_insignia.how: Carried, it speaks for you: there is nothing to do with it but have it in the pack.
rank_insignia.description: Your old rank, in bronze. Soldiers still straighten up for it, and a patrol of them on the road is easier to talk past.

trophy.name: trophy
trophy.description: A claw or tooth from an animal you killed. Worn on a thong at the neck it says so: +1 to Intimidation.

colleague_letter.name: letter from a dead colleague
colleague_letter.description: It poses a question you have not yet answered, about something old and lost. Read it.

guild_letter.name: guild letter of introduction
guild_letter.how: Carried, it speaks for you: there is nothing to do with it but have it in the pack.
guild_letter.description: A guild's seal and a master's word for you.

manacles.name: manacles
manacles.how: Used when you take a prisoner: one pair for each, and nobody slips them.
manacles.description: Iron cuffs on a short chain. A prisoner in them does not slip away on the road to the watch.

potion_healing.name: potion of healing
potion_healing.description: A small flask of red liquid that glimmers when shaken and tastes of iron and honey. Drunk, or poured into a friend beside you, it closes wounds (2d4 + 2 hit points; a bonus action in a fight).

potion_healing_greater.name: potion of greater healing
potion_healing_greater.description: A heavier flask of the red draught, darker and thick as syrup, that glimmers when shaken. It closes deep wounds (4d4 + 4 hit points; a bonus action in a fight).

potion_healing_superior.name: potion of superior healing
potion_healing_superior.description: A stoppered vial of red so deep it is nearly black until shaken, when it glimmers like embers. It pulls the dying back from the edge (8d4 + 8 hit points; a bonus action in a fight).

potion_healing_supreme.name: potion of supreme healing
potion_healing_supreme.description: A crystal phial sealed with wax and a temple's mark, the red within glimmering even at rest. Kings have killed for less (10d4 + 20 hit points; a bonus action in a fight).

holy_water.name: flask of holy water
holy_water.description: Blessed at a temple and stoppered with wax.

alchemists_fire.name: flask of alchemist's fire
alchemists_fire.description: Sticky stuff in a stoppered flask that bursts into flame when the air gets at it.

diamond.name: diamond
diamond.description: A clear stone the size of a pea. Priests pay dearly for them.
diamond.how: A spell's costly component: Revivify burns one away to call back someone dead no more than a minute.

diamond_dust.name: vial of diamond dust
diamond_dust.description: A stoppered vial of glittering grit, ground from flawed stones. Worth a hundred crowns to the right buyer.
diamond_dust.how: A spell's costly component: Stoneskin uses up a vial.

black_pearl.name: black pearl
black_pearl.description: A pearl as dark as a crow's eye, with a sheen of green and violet when it turns.
black_pearl.how: A spell's costly component: Circle of Death needs its powder, ground as the spell is cast (the pearl is not used up).

mushroom_powder.name: pinch of mushroom powder
mushroom_powder.description: A twist of waxed paper holding a grey powder of dried cave mushrooms, bitter to smell.
mushroom_powder.how: A spell's costly component: True Seeing uses up a pinch as it is cast.

ruby_dust.name: vial of ruby dust
ruby_dust.description: A stoppered vial of finely ground rubies, glowing like embers when the light catches it.
ruby_dust.how: A spell's costly component: Forcecage uses up a vial as it is cast.

miniature_sword.name: miniature platinum sword
miniature_sword.description: A sword no longer than a finger, perfect to the last rivet, made of platinum with a copper and zinc hilt.
miniature_sword.how: A spell's costly component: Mordenkainen's Sword is cast through it (it is not used up).

gilded_acorn.name: gilded acorn
gilded_acorn.description: An acorn of gold leaf over oak, hinged, with a feather, a tuft of fur and a dried fish tail sealed inside.
gilded_acorn.how: A spell's costly component, kept (it is not used up): Summon Beast is cast through it.

gilded_flower.name: gilded flower
gilded_flower.description: A wild rose dipped in gold so finely that every vein of its petals still shows.
gilded_flower.how: A spell's costly component, kept (it is not used up): Summon Fey is cast through it.

gilded_skull.name: gilded skull
gilded_skull.description: A small human skull covered in gold leaf, the eye sockets left dark.
gilded_skull.how: A spell's costly component, kept (it is not used up): Summon Undead is cast through it.

platinum_vial.name: platinum-inlaid vial
platinum_vial.description: A glass vial bound in platinum wire; inside, in cloudy brine, a pickled tentacle curls round an eyeball that seems to follow you.
platinum_vial.how: A spell's costly component, kept (it is not used up): Summon Aberration is cast through it.

lockbox.name: ornate lockbox
lockbox.description: A little strongbox of blued steel and brass, its lock a puzzle of tiny wheels.
lockbox.how: A spell's costly component, kept (it is not used up): Summon Construct is cast through it.

elemental_vial.name: gold-inlaid vial
elemental_vial.description: A vial inlaid with gold that holds a breath of air, a pebble, a pinch of ash and a drop of water, none of them touching.
elemental_vial.how: A spell's costly component, kept (it is not used up): Summon Elemental is cast through it.

silver_reliquary.name: silver reliquary
silver_reliquary.description: A little house of silver and rock crystal, the size of a hand, holding a saint's knucklebone on a bed of faded silk.
silver_reliquary.how: A spell's costly component, kept (it is not used up): Summon Celestial is cast through it.

dragon_token.name: dragon-engraved token
dragon_token.description: A heavy disc of old silver, worn smooth at the rim, with a coiled dragon cut deep into its face.
dragon_token.how: A spell's costly component, kept (it is not used up): Summon Dragon is cast through it.

bloody_vial.name: bloody vial
bloody_vial.description: A vial of smoked glass stoppered with black wax; the blood inside never dries and never settles.
bloody_vial.how: A spell's costly component, kept (it is not used up): Summon Fiend is cast through it.

black_onyx.name: black onyx
black_onyx.description: A polished stone as black as a well at night, cold in the hand however long you hold it.
black_onyx.how: A spell's costly component, kept (it is not used up): Create Undead needs one for each corpse it raises.

forked_rod.name: forked metal rod
forked_rod.description: A two-tined rod of tuned metal that hums faintly when struck, as if answering a sound from far away.
forked_rod.how: A spell's costly component: Plane Shift is cast through it (it is not used up).

fine_diamond.name: fine diamond
fine_diamond.description: A clear, bright diamond the size of a fingernail, cut to throw the light about.
fine_diamond.how: A spell's costly component: Raise Dead burns one away to call back someone ten days dead.

ruby_dust_pinch.name: pinch of ruby dust
ruby_dust_pinch.description: A twist of paper holding a pinch of red grit ground from a flawed ruby.
ruby_dust_pinch.how: A spell's costly component: Continual Flame burns it away to light a flame that never goes out.

rare_inks.name: rare inks and chalks
rare_inks.description: Stoppered pots of inks that shimmer as they dry, and sticks of chalk ground with powdered gems.
rare_inks.how: A spell's costly component: Teleportation Circle uses them up to draw the circle's sigils.

divination_tools.name: divination tools
divination_tools.description: A carved box of rune-bones and painted cards, worn smooth by a seer's fingers.
divination_tools.how: A spell's costly component, kept: Find the Path is cast over them.

jacinth.name: jacinth
jacinth.description: A deep orange-red stone, clear as wine, that seems to hold a flame inside.
jacinth.how: A spell's costly component: Astral Projection burns one away for each traveller, with a silver bar of 100 GP.

jade_dust.name: pinch of jade dust
jade_dust.description: A twist of paper holding a green powder ground from flawed jade, cool to the touch.
jade_dust.how: A spell's costly component: Magic Mouth uses up a pinch; Programmed Illusion needs one at hand.

lead_ink.name: pot of lead ink
lead_ink.description: A small stoppered pot of grey, heavy ink that dries with a dull sheen.
lead_ink.how: A spell's costly component: Illusory Script uses up a pot.

diamond_dust_pinch.name: pinch of diamond dust
diamond_dust_pinch.description: A twist of paper holding a pinch of glittering grit from a flawed diamond.
diamond_dust_pinch.how: A spell's costly component: Nondetection uses up a pinch.

seers_incense.name: seer's incense
seers_incense.description: A cone of resinous incense flecked with gold leaf, its smoke curling into shapes that seem to mean something.
seers_incense.how: A spell's costly component: Divination burns a cone away as the question is asked.

burning_incense.name: burning incense
burning_incense.description: A coil of dark, costly incense that smoulders for an hour and smells of somewhere far away.
burning_incense.how: A spell's costly component: Find Familiar burns a coil away while the spirit is called.

rare_incense.name: rare incense
rare_incense.description: A lacquered box of dark incense from far away, sealed with a temple's wax; it smells of old stone and cedar.
rare_incense.how: A spell's costly component: Legend Lore burns a box away as the lore comes.

ivory_strips.name: ivory strips
ivory_strips.description: Four strips of polished ivory, each carved with a ring of tiny runes, bound with a silk cord.
ivory_strips.how: A spell's costly component, kept: Legend Lore is cast over them.

glass_eye.name: glass eye
glass_eye.description: A glass eye with a jewelled iris, the kind seers keep in a velvet box and never wear.
glass_eye.how: A spell's costly component, kept: Clairvoyance is cast through it.

scrying_mirror.name: scrying mirror
scrying_mirror.description: A hand mirror of polished silver in a frame of black wood, its face always a little darker than the room.
scrying_mirror.how: A spell's costly component, kept: Scrying is cast into it.

sapphire.name: sapphire
sapphire.description: A blue sapphire as big as a thumbnail, cut to catch the light.
sapphire.how: A spell's costly component: Drawmij's Instant Summons writes a thing's name in it, and crushing it calls the thing to your hand.

great_diamond.name: great diamond
great_diamond.description: A diamond the size of a quail's egg, its fire enough to light a room. Few kings own one.
great_diamond.how: A spell's costly component, kept: Gate is cast through it.

everburning_torch.name: everburning torch
everburning_torch.description: A torch whose flame gives no heat and never goes out (Continual Flame). It can be covered, never put out.
everburning_torch.how: Carried, it lights the way under the ground and in the dark like a torch, for ever.

flawless_diamond.name: flawless diamond
flawless_diamond.description: A diamond as big as a thumbnail without a fleck in it. Temples keep such stones under lock for the day they are needed.
flawless_diamond.how: A spell's costly component: Resurrection burns one away (Raise Dead will take one too).

diamond_hoard.name: casket of diamonds
diamond_hoard.description: A small silver casket packed in velvet with a hundred and more diamonds, a prince's ransom.
diamond_hoard.how: A spell's costly component: True Resurrection burns the whole casket away.

rare_oils.name: flask of rare oils
rare_oils.description: A sealed flask of golden oils pressed from flowers that bloom once a generation, sweet and heavy to smell.
rare_oils.how: A spell's costly component: Reincarnate anoints a body with them, and they are used up.

feast_bowl.name: gem-encrusted bowl
feast_bowl.description: A wide gold bowl crusted with garnets and pearls, too fine to eat from on any common day.
feast_bowl.how: A spell's costly component: Heroes' Feast is served from it, and it melts away with the last dish.

miniature_door.name: miniature door
miniature_door.description: A finger-high door of carved ivory and silver, with hinges that turn and a latch that clicks.
miniature_door.how: A spell's costly component: Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion is opened through it (it is not used up).

goodberry.name: goodberry
goodberry.description: A plump red berry, warm to the touch, humming faintly with magic.
goodberry.how: Eaten like any food: one feeds a body for a day and heals a hit point. They are gone a day after they were made.

conjured_food.name: day's conjured food
conjured_food.description: Bread, cheese and dried fruit made by a spell: bland, but it fills you.
conjured_food.how: Eaten like any food; it spoils a day after it was made.

pearl.name: pearl
pearl.description: A pearl of good size and a soft lustre, wrapped in a scrap of velvet.
pearl.how: A spell's costly component: a wizard looks through one to Identify a thing (it is not used up).

rations.name: day's trail rations
rations.description: Hard biscuit, dried meat, dried fruit, nuts.

wild_food.name: handful of wild food
wild_food.description: Berries, nuts, roots and greens: whatever the land offered.

fodder.name: bag of fodder
fodder.how: Your animals eat a bag a day when there is no grazing.
fodder.description: Oats and hay: a day's feed for a horse or mule.

firewood.name: bundle of firewood
firewood.how: Burned at camp when there is nothing to gather (r, then f).
firewood.description: Enough dry wood for a night's fire.

spirits.name: flask of spirits
spirits.description: Clear, fierce stuff. Warms the belly, dulls the pain, and cleans a wound better than water.

poppy_milk.name: vial of poppy milk
poppy_milk.description: Bitter white syrup. It takes pain away for a night, and some people never stop wanting it.

healing_herbs.name: bundle of healing herbs
healing_herbs.description: Yarrow, comfrey and woundwort, for poultices against festering.

fine_wine.name: bottle of fine wine
fine_wine.description: A vintage from a good year, sealed with wax. Lords and their stewards notice who carries such a thing.

plain_ring.name: ring
plain_ring.description: A plain silver band. Worn, it makes you look a little better off.

amulet.name: amulet
amulet.description: A silver pendant on a chain. Worn, it makes you look a little better off.

gold_ring.name: gold ring
gold_ring.description: A heavy gold ring, taken from a dead hand.

silver_chalice.name: silver chalice
silver_chalice.description: A cup for wine or for the gods, dented.

gemstone.name: gemstone
gemstone.description: A cut stone that takes the light.

jewelled_brooch.name: jewelled brooch
jewelled_brooch.description: A cloak-pin set with red stones, very old.

gem_10.name: small stone
gem_10.description: A pretty stone, polished. A jeweller would give a little for it.

gem_50.name: fair stone
gem_50.description: A clear, well-cut stone. Worth a good horse's shoeing many times over.

gem_100.name: fine stone
gem_100.description: A stone that catches the eye from across a room.

gem_500.name: precious stone
gem_500.description: A stone a merchant would want to see in daylight before naming a price.

gem_1000.name: rare stone
gem_1000.description: A stone of the kind kings set in rings. Few in any town could pay what it is worth.

gem_5000.name: great stone
gem_5000.description: A stone with a name and a history, if anyone remembered them. Fortunes have changed hands for less.

gold_dust.name: pinch of gold dust
gold_dust.description: A twist of paper holding a pinch of gold dust, panned from some mountain stream.
gold_dust.how: A spell's costly component: Arcane Lock uses up a pinch.

leomunds_chest.name: exquisite chest
leomunds_chest.description: A chest of black wood inlaid with silver and mother-of-pearl, three feet by two, its lock a work of art.
leomunds_chest.how: Carried, it holds things. A spell's costly component: Leomund's Secret Chest hides it, and what it holds, on the Ethereal Plane.

chest_replica.name: tiny replica chest
chest_replica.description: A chest the size of a thumb, of black wood inlaid with silver, a perfect copy of a larger one.
chest_replica.how: Leomund's Secret Chest needs it beside the chest. Touch it (Enter in the pack) to call the hidden chest back from the Ethereal Plane.

glyph_diamond_dust.name: pouch of powdered diamond
glyph_diamond_dust.description: A small leather pouch of diamond ground fine as flour; it glitters when the neck is opened.
glyph_diamond_dust.how: A spell's costly component: Glyph of Warding uses up a pouch as the glyph is drawn.

symbol_diamond_dust.name: jar of powdered diamond
symbol_diamond_dust.description: A heavy little crystal jar, stoppered and sealed, full of diamond dust: a fortune you could blow away.
symbol_diamond_dust.how: A spell's costly component: Symbol uses up a jar as the glyph is drawn.

silver_rod.name: silver rod
silver_rod.description: A rod of polished silver as long as a hand, ringed with tiny engraved runes.
silver_rod.how: A spell's costly component, kept: Guards and Wards is woven round it.

hallowing_incense.name: hallowing incense
hallowing_incense.description: A temple's casket of rare resins and sacred oils, enough to burn through a day and a night of prayer.
hallowing_incense.how: A spell's costly component: Hallow burns the whole casket through its day of prayer.

silvered_salt.name: silvered salt
silvered_salt.description: A pouch of coarse white salt mixed with powdered silver, blessed and tied with a red cord.
silvered_salt.how: A spell's costly component: Magic Circle pours a pouch out in its ring.

gilded_ladle.name: gilded ladle
gilded_ladle.description: A long ladle of gilded silver, its bowl worked with bubbles and its handle with a crooked witch's hat.
gilded_ladle.how: A spell's costly component, kept: Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron is stirred with it.

contingency_statuette.name: jewelled statuette
contingency_statuette.description: A hand-high figure of its owner in gilded bronze, crusted with little gems, its face a good likeness.
contingency_statuette.how: A spell's costly component, kept and carried: a Contingency waits on whoever it shows.

clone_vessel.name: sealable vessel
clone_vessel.description: A long vessel of glazed stone with a lid that seals with lead, as big as a coffin and worked like a shrine.
clone_vessel.how: A spell's costly component: Clone grows its duplicate inside it, and it stays with the clone.

imprisonment_statuette.name: blank jade statuette
imprisonment_statuette.description: A figure of green jade with no face, its limbs bound with carved chains. It is said to take the likeness of whatever it holds.
imprisonment_statuette.how: A spell's costly component: Imprisonment takes it, and it becomes the likeness of the one bound.

art_25.name: trinket
art_25.description: A small, well-made thing: somebody's treasure once.

art_250.name: fine piece
art_250.description: Fine work, of the kind a lord keeps on a shelf to be seen.

art_750.name: precious piece
art_750.description: A masterwork. Someone will know who made it, and want it back.

art_2500.name: treasure
art_2500.description: A thing for a palace, not a pack.

art_7500.name: great treasure
art_7500.description: A treasure of a royal house. There are not many buyers, and some of them are thieves.

silver_bar.name: silver bar
silver_bar.description: Five pounds of silver, stamped. Merchants take it gladly instead of coin.

gold_bar.name: gold bar
gold_bar.description: Five pounds of gold, stamped. Carrying it openly is asking for a knife.

alchemists_supplies.name: alchemist's supplies
alchemists_supplies.description: Glass tubes, a small burner, mortar and pestle and stoppered jars of salts. Tells one substance from another and can light a fire the hard way.

uses.text: Work out what a substance is

alchemists_supplies.how: Those trained with it add their proficiency to checks made with it; its Utilize uses are on its card, and it makes things at camp (m).

brewers_supplies.name: brewer's supplies
brewers_supplies.description: A copper kettle, a long spoon, yeast and a hydrometer. Good for judging drink: strength, age and whether it has been tampered with.
brewers_supplies.how: Those trained with it add their proficiency to checks made with it; its Utilize uses are on its card, and it makes things at camp (m).

calligraphers_supplies.name: calligrapher's supplies
calligraphers_supplies.description: Pens, ink-cakes and a ruled board. A clerk's hand can flourish a page so that a forger would struggle to copy it.

uses.text: Write with flourishes that deter forgers

calligraphers_supplies.how: Those trained with it add their proficiency to checks made with it; its Utilize uses are on its card, and it makes things at camp (m).

cartographers_tools.name: cartographer's tools
cartographers_tools.description: Compass, dividers, rulers and a roll of fine skins. For drawing what you have walked so others can follow it.

uses.text: Draw a map of a small area

cartographers_tools.how: Those trained with it add their proficiency to checks made with it; its Utilize uses are on its card, and it makes things at camp (m).

cobblers_tools.name: cobbler's tools
cobblers_tools.description: Lasts, awls, a heel knife and nails. Can shape soles and heels for better grip, and keeps boots from falling apart.

uses.text: Alter footwear so the next Acrobatics check is easier

glassblowers_tools.name: glassblower's tools
glassblowers_tools.description: Blowpipe, tongs, shears and a paddle. Lets you read a glass thing's past use by its shape, stains and smell.

uses.text: Tell what a glass object held in the last day

jewelers_tools.name: jeweller's tools
jewelers_tools.description: Loupe, tweezers, small pliers and files. A trained eye sets a price on a stone and keeps small gold and silver work sound.

uses.text: Judge what a gem is worth

masons_tools.name: mason's tools
masons_tools.description: Mallet, chisels, a plumb line and a trowel. Cuts marks and holes in stone and builds with it.

uses.text: Chisel a symbol or a hole in stone

painters_supplies.name: painter's supplies
painters_supplies.description: Brushes, pigments, an easel and a palette. Good for putting a face or a place on a surface from memory.

uses.text: Paint a likeness of something you have seen

painters_supplies.how: Those trained with it add their proficiency to checks made with it; its Utilize uses are on its card, and it makes things at camp (m).

potters_tools.name: potter's tools
potters_tools.description: Wire cutters, ribs, a wheel-stick and a lump of clay. Fired clay tells a trained hand what it once held.

uses.text: Tell what a ceramic object held in the last day

tinkers_tools.name: tinker's tools
tinkers_tools.description: Tiny files, pliers, springs, wire and screws. In clever hands, anything small and broken can be mended, or made to move again.

uses.text: Put together a Tiny thing from scrap; it falls apart in a minute

weavers_tools.name: weaver's tools
weavers_tools.description: Needles, shears, a small loom and thread. Mends torn clothes and stitches small patterns.

woodcarvers_tools.name: woodcarver's tools
woodcarvers_tools.description: Knives, gouges and a small saw. Cuts patterns into wood and keeps wooden and bone things whole.

forgery_kit.name: forgery kit
forgery_kit.how: Used to forge papers: a false pass, letter or seal made at a desk takes a long steady hand, and shows if a clerk looks twice.
forgery_kit.description: Inks, quills, scraps of old parchment and wax with a few blank seals. Make a letter look as if another hand wrote it.

uses.text: Copy ten words or fewer of another's handwriting

poisoners_kit.name: poisoner's kit
poisoners_kit.how: At camp (m) it brews a basic poison to coat a blade; those trained with it also spot poison in an object.
poisoners_kit.description: Vials, a mortar, a mask and gloves, and a small book of dangerous plants. Sniffs out poison and makes some of its own.

dragonchess_set.name: dragonchess set
dragonchess_set.description: A board of three stacked layers with carved pieces, played slowly. A game in the evening cheers the camp; at an inn the trained play better.

three_dragon_ante_set.name: Three-Dragon Ante set
three_dragon_ante_set.description: A worn deck of dragon cards for a game of bluff and nerve. A game in the evening cheers the camp; at an inn the trained play better.

bagpipes.name: bagpipes
bagpipes.description: A bag, a blowpipe and drones. Loud, carrying and hard to ignore; playing for an inn pays better with it, much better if you were taught.

uses.text: Make up a song on the spot

drum.name: drum
drum.description: A skin stretched over a wooden hoop. Marches and dances keep to its beat; playing for an inn pays better if you were taught.

uses.text: Make up a song on the spot

dulcimer.name: dulcimer
dulcimer.description: A flat box strung with many wires, struck with small hammers. Playing for an inn pays better with it, much better if you were taught.

uses.text: Make up a song on the spot

horn.name: horn
horn.description: A curved horn with a plain, far-carrying note. Playing for an inn pays better if you were taught.

uses.text: Make up a song on the spot

lyre.name: lyre
lyre.description: A small frame harp for singing along. Playing for an inn pays better with it, much better if you were taught.

uses.text: Make up a song on the spot

pan_flute.name: pan flute
pan_flute.description: Reed pipes bound side by side, blown across the tops. Playing for an inn pays better if you were taught.

uses.text: Make up a song on the spot

shawm.name: shawm
shawm.description: A reedy, piercing double-reed pipe, made for fairs and feasts. Playing for an inn pays better if you were taught.

uses.text: Make up a song on the spot

viol.name: viol
viol.description: A bowed, fretted fiddle with a low, mournful voice. Playing for an inn pays better with it, much better if you were taught.

uses.text: Make up a song on the spot

acid.name: vial of acid
acid.description: A stoppered vial of something that eats flesh and metal alike. Thrown, it burns whatever it lands on.
acid.how: Thrown in a fight, in place of a blow. The target must dodge or be burned (2d6 acid damage).

antitoxin.name: vial of antitoxin
antitoxin.description: A bitter green draught brewed against venom. It will not cure poison, but for an hour the body fights it off.
antitoxin.how: Drink it (Enter on it in the pack): for an hour you have advantage on saves against poison.

ball_bearings.name: ball bearings
ball_bearings.description: A leather pouch of small steel balls. Spilled across a floor, they send running feet out from under their owners.
ball_bearings.how: Spilled in a fight over a 10-foot square: those who enter must make a Dexterity save or fall prone.

caltrops.name: caltrops
caltrops.description: A bag of four-pointed iron spikes that always land with one point up. A cruel thing to leave in a doorway.
caltrops.how: Scattered in a fight over a 5-foot square: whoever enters must save or be hurt and stop short.

net.name: net
net.description: A weighted fishing net, knotted tight. Thrown well, it tangles a man up like a trout.
net.how: Thrown in a fight: the target must make a Dexterity save or be held fast until it breaks free.

basic_poison.name: vial of basic poison
basic_poison.description: A thin, oily venom in a corked vial, sold quietly and never by the honest.
basic_poison.how: Use it in a fight as a bonus action to coat your weapon: its hits do an extra 1d4 poison damage for a minute.

glass_bottle.name: glass bottle
glass_bottle.description: A bottle of greenish glass with a cork. Holds a pint and a half, and breaks if you drop it.

flask.name: flask
flask.description: A small clay or pewter flask for a pint of something.

jug.name: jug
jug.description: A fat stoneware jug with a loop handle. Holds a gallon.

vial.name: vial
vial.description: A tiny glass vial with a stopper, for scents, tinctures and worse. Holds a few mouthfuls.

bucket.name: bucket
bucket.description: A wooden bucket with a rope handle. Holds about half a cubic foot, which is a good deal of water.

basket.name: basket
basket.description: A wicker basket with a handle, for eggs, bread and whatever else you pick up.
basket.how: Carried, it holds things: 10 pounds more before you count as laden.

pouch.name: belt pouch
pouch.description: A small leather pouch on a thong, for coins and small things.
pouch.how: Carried, it holds things: 2 pounds more before you count as laden.

quiver.name: quiver
quiver.description: A leather tube slung at the hip, made to hold twenty arrows.
quiver.how: Carried, it holds things: 2 pounds more before you count as laden.

bolt_case.name: bolt case
bolt_case.description: A stiff leather case with a lid, made to hold twenty crossbow bolts.
bolt_case.how: Carried, it holds things: 2 pounds more before you count as laden.

scroll_case.name: map or scroll case
scroll_case.description: A tube of oiled leather with a cap, to keep maps and scrolls dry and flat.
scroll_case.how: Carried, it holds things: 1 pounds more before you count as laden.

bell.name: bell
bell.description: A small hand bell with a clear, carrying note.
bell.how: Carried, it is strung up at camp like the string of bells and warns of whoever comes creeping.

chain.name: chain
chain.description: Ten feet of heavy iron chain, links as thick as a thumb. Harder to slip than rope and harder to cut.
chain.how: Used when you take a prisoner, as rope is, but nobody slips it.

pole.name: ten-foot pole
pole.description: A long pole of ash, ten feet from end to end. Poke the floor before you step on it.
pole.how: Carried underground, you prod ahead of the party: +5 to the party's passive Perception against traps.

magnifying_glass.name: magnifying glass
magnifying_glass.description: A ground lens in a brass rim. Shows fine work, faint scratches and the seams in a wall.
magnifying_glass.how: Carried, it gives you advantage when you search for traps and hidden doors.

portable_ram.name: portable ram
portable_ram.description: A beam of oak with an iron head and handles to carry it. Doors do not argue with it for long.
portable_ram.how: Carried, it adds +4 when you force a lock or break down a door.

costume.name: costume
costume.description: Paint, a mask and a borrowed manner: the clothes of a priest, a guard, a king's fool, whoever you need to be.
costume.how: Worn, it gives you advantage when you pass yourself off as someone else.

robe.name: robe
robe.description: A plain long robe, the dress of scholars, monks and anyone else with business in a church.

mirror.name: steel mirror
mirror.description: A polished steel mirror the size of a hand. Good for the vain, for looking round corners and for flashing signals.
mirror.how: Carried, it helps you make an impression on people of rank: +2.

perfume.name: perfume
perfume.description: A little vial of scent, rose or musk. In a court it smooths the way.
perfume.how: Carried, it helps you make an impression on people of rank: +3.

lamp.name: oil lamp
lamp.description: A small iron lamp with a wick. Steadier than a torch and it burns oil, not pitch.

bullseye_lantern.name: bullseye lantern
bullseye_lantern.description: A lantern with a thick lens that throws all its light in one long beam. You see far, though not to the sides.

map.name: map
map.description: A drawn map of a country or a town. Someone has walked it, or says they have.
map.how: Carried, it helps you keep your bearings in the place it shows.

ladder.name: ladder
ladder.description: A ten-foot wooden ladder. Awkward to carry, and always the thing you need.
ladder.how: Carried on the road, a ladder lets you go over a town wall at night when the gate is shut, and cut down a hanged body from a gibbet.

block_and_tackle.name: block and tackle
block_and_tackle.description: Pulleys and rope, which let one pair of arms lift what four could not.
block_and_tackle.how: A rope-and-pulley rig that turns a heave into a task for two: used to haul a carter's cart out of the mud, drag rockfall slabs aside, and bring a fallen climber up a ravine.

iron_spikes.name: iron spikes
iron_spikes.description: A bundle of ten iron spikes. Hammered into wood or earth they hold a rope, or jam a door.
iron_spikes.how: Spikes are driven into a wall's mortar to climb over a shut town gate at night, or into a crack to anchor a rope when going down a ravine after someone fallen.

lock.name: lock
lock.description: A good iron lock with its key. A thief with the right tools can still beat it.
lock.how: Locked through a prisoner's bonds, it holds them as surely as manacles: nobody slips away on the road.

signal_whistle.name: signal whistle
signal_whistle.description: A shrill little whistle that carries a long way over open ground.
signal_whistle.how: Blown to raise an alarm: it brings help for someone fallen in a ravine, and frightens hungry deserters when you pretend a patrol is close.

string.name: string
string.description: Ten feet of stout twine. Has more uses than you expect.
string.how: With a bell on it, a length of string makes a trip-line you can hang across the way while you search an abandoned camp, so no bandit comes up behind you.

climbers_kit.name: climber's kit
climbers_kit.description: Boot spikes, gloves, pitons and a harness: all that a man needs to go up a cliff and not come down it fast.
climbers_kit.how: Pitons, hammer and a rope belay: lets you go up a shut town's wall at night with an easier climb, or down a ravine to bring up someone who has fallen.

burglars_pack.name: burglar's pack
burglars_pack.description: A pack made for quiet work: bearings to spill behind you, a bell to warn, a crowbar, a lantern and oil to feed it.
burglars_pack.how: Open it in the pack (Enter): it becomes what is in it.

diplomats_pack.name: diplomat's pack
diplomats_pack.description: What a messenger of state carries: good clothes, paper, ink, scent and a lamp to write by.
diplomats_pack.how: Open it in the pack (Enter): it becomes what is in it.

dungeoneers_pack.name: dungeoneer's pack
dungeoneers_pack.description: The plain kit for going under the ground: torches, oil, rope, food for ten days and a bar to open what is shut.
dungeoneers_pack.how: Open it in the pack (Enter): it becomes what is in it.

entertainers_pack.name: entertainer's pack
entertainers_pack.description: A player's kit: bedroll, costumes, a mirror and a lantern bright enough to light a stage.
entertainers_pack.how: Open it in the pack (Enter): it becomes what is in it.

explorers_pack.name: explorer's pack
explorers_pack.description: What anyone sensible takes into the wild: a bed, rope, torches and ten days of food.
explorers_pack.how: Open it in the pack (Enter): it becomes what is in it.

priests_pack.name: priest's pack
priests_pack.description: A cleric's travelling things: a robe, a blanket, a lamp, a week of food and a flask of holy water.
priests_pack.how: Open it in the pack (Enter): it becomes what is in it.

scholars_pack.name: scholar's pack
scholars_pack.description: A student's pack: ink, parchment, a lamp and oil enough for a good many late nights.
scholars_pack.how: Open it in the pack (Enter): it becomes what is in it.

mistletoe_sprig.name: sprig of mistletoe
mistletoe_sprig.description: A cut sprig of mistletoe, white-berried and tied with thread. A druid's focus.

druid_staff.name: wooden staff
druid_staff.description: A staff of living wood, carved with leaves and knots. A druid's focus, and a fair quarterstaff too.

yew_wand.name: yew wand
yew_wand.description: A thin wand of yew, pale and smooth. A druid's focus.

arcane_orb.name: arcane orb
arcane_orb.description: A heavy glass orb with a slow light moving in it. A caster's focus.

arcane_rod.name: arcane rod
arcane_rod.description: A rod of dark metal inlaid with silver script. A caster's focus.

arcane_staff.name: arcane staff
arcane_staff.description: A tall staff, carved with sigils and capped with a stone. A caster's focus, and a fair quarterstaff.

arcane_wand.name: arcane wand
arcane_wand.description: A slim wand of bone-white wood, bound with wire. A caster's focus.

holy_emblem.name: holy emblem
holy_emblem.description: A faith's sign stitched on a tabard or painted on a shield. A priest's focus.

gilded_reliquary.name: gilded reliquary
gilded_reliquary.description: A casket of gold on little lion's feet, set with garnets and lapis, a saint's finger-bone lying behind a pane of rock crystal.
gilded_reliquary.how: A priest's focus, and a spell's costly component: Holy Aura is cast through it (it is not used up).

reliquary.name: reliquary
reliquary.description: A little casket holding a saint's bone or a scrap of cloth. A priest's focus, held in the hand.

trinket.name: trinket
trinket.how: A keepsake: something to turn over in the hand by the fire, and worth a silver penny to a pedlar who collects such things.
trinket.description: A small curious thing of no use to anyone.

riding_saddle.name: riding saddle
riding_saddle.how: Carried with your animals: whoever rides with a saddle rides easy and tires little; bareback, a rider tires as much as a walker.
riding_saddle.description: Leather on a wooden tree, with stirrups, a bit, a bridle and reins.

military_saddle.name: military saddle
military_saddle.how: A saddle like any other on the road: a rider with one tires little. (Its high seat holds you in a fight from the saddle, which comes with a later expansion.)
military_saddle.description: A deep seat between a high cantle and pommel, iron-bound, made to keep a rider on a horse that is being hit.

exotic_saddle.name: exotic saddle
exotic_saddle.how: The only seat on an elephant's back: without it nobody rides one. On any other mount it serves as a saddle.
exotic_saddle.description: A padded, railed seat on broad girths, built for a beast no ordinary saddle fits.

barrel.name: barrel
barrel.how: Filled at a well or a river (w), it holds forty gallons: water for a whole party on a long dry road. Too heavy to carry far without a cart.
barrel.description: Oak staves and iron hoops, tight enough for water or wine.

chest.name: chest
chest.how: Carried, it holds things: 40 pounds more before you count as laden. Heavy itself: best on a cart or a mule.
chest.description: A stout iron-bound box with a hasp for a lock.
